product.title: NFL System Stress Test
product.summary: Judge whether a shock strengthens, strains or breaks an organisation.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students read fifteen real stress scenarios across five teams, each with its own organisational profile, and classify each as something the system needs, absorbs, is strained by, or breaks under. A tutorial mode walks three scenarios with answers shown; the real mode runs all fifteen blind and scored.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: The most thoroughly self-documented repo in the Track 301 set, including its own honest list of limitations. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: GitHub Pages returned 200 on 2026-08-14. Reachability only.
